body:
Founder real-time: 'we need to add body blocking' -> 'currently players can ghost through eachother.' New resolve_hero_hero_collision, same shape as the existing resolve_hero_obstacle_collision -- a hero is now also a circle (ARENA_HERO_COLLISION_RADIUS) every other hero pushes itself back out of. Called from update_hero_motion's own movement step, same donkey-glide skip as obstacle collision. Applies regardless of team (real MOBA convention) and across the full clone range. Deliberately not applied to forced displacement (pulls/dashes) -- those bypass update_hero_motion, next tick's normal movement self-corrects. update_hero_motion gained a self_index param, all 3 call sites updated. 4 new tests, full suite (857 checks) green. No PARENA mod -- pure engine mechanic, not asked for as a mod. REDGARDEN commit ce3176a.

⚓ ☃
title: Body blocking shipped -- real hero-hero collision (S202-27)
